question: Do EMA features add directional information beyond context, at NQ 5 and 15 minutes?
width: per block: lin_pois_ivx refitted on the sessions before the block (validation: before the validation sessions), times fan_rw_v2's walk-forward sigma; v2's shape. The frozen width model is not used.

features.grid: the target's 1440 one-minute slots from 18:00 ET, sessions laid end to end in date order
features.price: log of the panel's last close known at the end of each minute (carried, never filled backwards)
features.ema: Pine ta.ema, alpha = 2 / (period + 1), seeded with the first value, on log price; periods [14, 100]
features.m1: updated only at minutes where a 1-minute bar closed (panel age 0), carried between
features.m5: 5-minute bars aligned to 18:00 ET; a bar completes at the end of its last minute and exists when a 1-minute bar closed inside it; its close is the last close known then; updated at completion, carried until the next completed bar - never from a bar still forming
features.warm_up: missing until the EMA has seen 3 x its period of its own bars
features.sd60: sqrt(mean of the last 60 squared one-minute log returns of the grid); missing when zero
features.slope: EMA_t - EMA_(t-15 min), over sd60 x sqrt(15)
features.dist: log price - EMA, over sd60 x sqrt(15)
features.gap: EMA 14 - EMA 100 of the timeframe, over sd60 x sqrt(15)
features.tf_agree: sign of m1_gap where it equals the sign of m5_gap, else 0
features.ret_w: log return over the last w minutes over sd60 x sqrt(w), w = 1, 5, 15
features.vwap_dist: log price - log session VWAP (closes x volume from 18:00 ET), over sd60 x sqrt(15)
features.context_base: rv15, rv60 (realised variance over usual for the time of day), vol60 (relative volume)
features.phase: the origin's session phase, a categorical input

model.family: HistGradientBoostingRegressor, one per horizon and arm

selection.validation: the last 20% of the block's training sessions
selection.loss: mean over validation sessions of the session's mean CRPS of the shifted fan
selection.activation: the best option is used only if its paired session-level 99.58% moving-block interval against zero shift (95 %, Bonferroni over the options searched) lies wholly below zero; otherwise zero
selection.refit: an activated option is refitted on every training session (width likewise)

labels: outcomes end inside their own session (t + h before the day's end); sessions are split whole, so no training label reaches into validation or evaluation

evaluation.blocks: the intermarket experiment's three checks, then its spent holdout in two blocks of 30

decision.pass: at a horizon, C - A and C - B both have their 97.5% interval wholly below zero (Bonferroni over the two horizons); the experiment passes if either horizon does
decision.fail: at both horizons C's mean CRPS is not below both A's and B's: no incremental EMA benefit
decision.after_pass: freeze the full specification and evaluate on fresh, timely forward data before any overlay

diagnostics.extension: terciles of |m1_dist100| with boundaries from the block's training rows
diagnostics.use: explanation only - never a deployment rule
